# dotplots

## haplotype 1 vs primary

```{r}
# ---- 1. Read PAF ----
paf_cols <- c("qname", "qlen", "qstart", "qend", "strand",
              "tname", "tlen", "tstart", "tend",
              "nmatch", "alen", "mapq")

paf <- read_tsv("../../resources/dotplots/hap1_vs_primary.paf", col_names = FALSE, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
paf <- paf[, 1:12]                      # keep only the 12 mandatory columns
colnames(paf) <- paf_cols

paf <- paf %>%
  mutate(across(c(qlen, qstart, qend, tlen, tstart, tend, nmatch, alen, mapq), as.numeric),
         pident = nmatch / alen)        # approximate % identity per alignment block

# ---- 2. Filter low alignment blocks ----
paf_f <- paf %>%
  filter(alen >= 1000, mapq >= 1)

# ---- 3. Orient reverse-strand alignments for correct diagonal direction ----
paf_plot <- paf_f %>%
  mutate(
    tstart_plot = if_else(strand == "-", tend, tstart),
    tend_plot   = if_else(strand == "-", tstart, tend)
  )

# ---- 4. Simple whole-genome dotplot ----
ggplot(paf_plot) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = qstart, xend = qend,
                    y = tstart_plot, yend = tend_plot,
                    color = strand),
               linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("+" = "steelblue", "-" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(x = "Query (bp)", y = "Target (bp)",
       title = "minimap2 whole-genome alignment",
       color = "Strand") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

## 5. specific scaffold
for(tscaf in paste0("scaffold_", 1:51)){
    
  ggplot(subset(paf_plot, qname == "scaffold_25" & tname == tscaf)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = qstart, xend = qend,
                    y = tstart_plot, yend = tend_plot,
                    color = strand),
               linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("+" = "steelblue", "-" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(x ="Haplotype 1, scaffold 25 (bp)", y = paste0("Primary ", tscaf, " (bp)"),
       title = "minimap2 whole-genome alignment",
       color = "Strand") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  
  ggsave(paste0("../../results/by-date/", today, "/dotplot_hap1_scaffold_25_vs_primary_scaffold_", tscaf, ".pdf"), width = 6, height = 6)
}

```

## haplotype 1 and haplotype 2

check if myb cluster also present on haplotype 2


## haplotype 1 and 2

Code and alignment from yaniv

```{r}
x <- read_tsv("../../resources/dotplots/hap1_vs_hap2.1to1.coords", col_names = c("S1","E1" ,"S2","E2","LEN_1","LEN_2","PCT_IDY","LEN_R","LEN_Q","COV_R","COV_Q","REF_TAG","QUERY_TAG"))

make_plot <- function(scaffold){
  queery <- x|>
    filter(REF_TAG == scaffold) |>
    group_by(QUERY_TAG) |>
    summarise(tot = sum(LEN_2))|>
    mutate(prop = tot / sum(tot))|>
    filter(prop > 0.02)|>
    pull(QUERY_TAG)
  ggplot(x|> filter(REF_TAG==scaffold,QUERY_TAG %in% queery),
         aes(x = S1, xend = E1, y = S2, yend = E2 , color = QUERY_TAG))+
    geom_segment(linewidth = 2)+
    geom_vline(xintercept = 57821464) + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = 57828110) + 
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(axis.line = element_line(color = "black"))+
    ggtitle(scaffold)
}

make_plot("scaffold_1")
ggsave(paste0("../../results/by-date/", today, "/dotplot_scaffold1_g8317.pdf"))

scaffolds <- paste0("scaffold_", 1:36)

pdf(
  paste0("../../results/by-date/", today, "/hap1_vs_hap2_scaffolds_1_to_18.pdf"),
  width = 10,
  height = 7
)

purrr::walk(scaffolds, \(scaffold) {
  print(make_plot(scaffold))
})

dev.off()
```

```{r}
# Read the tree

     type = "phylogram")

myb_tree$tip.label
```

# mapping bias

```{r}
idxstats <- list.files(path = "../results/vg/hap1_vs_hap2", pattern = "idxstats.txt", recursive = T, full.names = T)

# Read and bind them while keeping the file names
idxstats <- idxstats %>% 
  set_names() %>% 
    map_dfr(fread, .id = "source_file")

# calculate 
idxstats <- idxstats %>%
  group_by(source_file) %>%
  reframe(mapped = sum(V3),
            unmapped = sum(V4)) %>%
  summarize(sample = 1:8,
            group = sample %% 2,
            pct_mapped = mapped/(mapped+unmapped))
```

# genome scans: pi, fst, tajima's D

```{r}
div_scans <- list.files(path = "../results/vg/hap2_vs_hap1", pattern = "interval_diversity", recursive = T, full.names = T)

# Read and bind them while keeping the file names
div_scans <- div_scans %>% 
  set_names() %>% 
  map_dfr(~fread(.x, col.names = c("chrom","start","end","total.masked","total.missing","total.empty","total.numeric","total.invariant","total.passed","missing","numeric","passed","theta_pi","theta_watterson","tajimas_d")), .id = "source_file")

# separate out sample and site class
div_scans$sample <- gsub("../results/vg/hap2_vs_hap1/|/diversity.*", "", div_scans$source_file)

div_scans$site_class <- gsub("../results/vg/hap2_vs_hap1/.*/diversity/|/grenedalf_results_interval.*", "", div_scans$source_file)

head(div_scans)

table(div_scans$site_class, div_scans$sample)

### rename samples
sample_lookup <- c(
  "1" = "1P", "2" = "1W",
  "3" = "2P", "4" = "2W",
  "5" = "3P", "6" = "3W",
  "7" = "4P", "8" = "4W"
)

div_scans <- div_scans %>%
  mutate(sample = recode(sample, !!!sample_lookup))

### include fst
fst_scans <- list.files(path = "../results/vg/hap2_vs_hap1", pattern = "interval_fst", recursive = T, full.names = T)

# Read and bind them while keeping the file names
fst_scans <- fst_scans %>% 
  set_names() %>% 
  map_dfr(~fread(.x, col.names = c("chrom","start","end","total.masked","total.missing","total.empty","total.numeric","total.invariant","total.passed","1:2.missing","1:2.numeric","1:2.passed","1:2.fst","1:3.missing","1:3.numeric","1:3.passed","1:3.fst","1:4.missing","1:4.numeric","1:4.passed","1:4.fst","1:5.missing","1:5.numeric","1:5.passed","1:5.fst","1:6.missing","1:6.numeric","1:6.passed","1:6.fst","1:7.missing","1:7.numeric","1:7.passed","1:7.fst","1:8.missing","1:8.numeric","1:8.passed","1:8.fst","2:3.missing","2:3.numeric","2:3.passed","2:3.fst","2:4.missing","2:4.numeric","2:4.passed","2:4.fst","2:5.missing","2:5.numeric","2:5.passed","2:5.fst","2:6.missing","2:6.numeric","2:6.passed","2:6.fst","2:7.missing","2:7.numeric","2:7.passed","2:7.fst","2:8.missing","2:8.numeric","2:8.passed","2:8.fst","3:4.missing","3:4.numeric","3:4.passed","3:4.fst","3:5.missing","3:5.numeric","3:5.passed","3:5.fst","3:6.missing","3:6.numeric","3:6.passed","3:6.fst","3:7.missing","3:7.numeric","3:7.passed","3:7.fst","3:8.missing","3:8.numeric","3:8.passed","3:8.fst","4:5.missing","4:5.numeric","4:5.passed","4:5.fst","4:6.missing","4:6.numeric","4:6.passed","4:6.fst","4:7.missing","4:7.numeric","4:7.passed","4:7.fst","4:8.missing","4:8.numeric","4:8.passed","4:8.fst","5:6.missing","5:6.numeric","5:6.passed","5:6.fst","5:7.missing","5:7.numeric","5:7.passed","5:7.fst","5:8.missing","5:8.numeric","5:8.passed","5:8.fst","6:7.missing","6:7.numeric","6:7.passed","6:7.fst","6:8.missing","6:8.numeric","6:8.passed","6:8.fst","7:8.missing","7:8.numeric","7:8.passed","7:8.fst")), .id = "source_file")

div_scans <- div_scans %>% 
  left_join(fst_scans, by = c("chrom", "start", "end", "site_class"))

#### plot total diversity ####

# 1. Split the data frame into a list of data frames by your variable
data_list <- split(div_scans, list(div_scans$chrom, div_scans$sample, div_scans$site_class), drop = T)

# 2. Open the PDF device

# 3. Map over the list, generate a standard plot for each subset, and print
walk(data_list, function(sub_data) {
p <- ggplot(sub_data,  aes(x = (start + end)/2, y = theta_pi)) +
  geom_point(shape = 16) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.2, se = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Window midpoint (bp)", 
       y = "Nucleotide diversity", 
       title = paste0(unique(sub_data$chrom), ", Sample: ", unique(sub_data$sample), ", Sites: ", unique(sub_data$site_class)))
  
  print(p)
})

# 4. Close the PDF device

### plot fst
fst_long <- fst_scans %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^\\d+:\\d+\\."),
    names_to = c("pair", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "^(\\d+:\\d+)\\.(.*)$"
  ) %>%
  separate(pair, into = c("idx1", "idx2"), sep = ":", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    sample1 = sample_lookup[idx1],
    sample2 = sample_lookup[idx2],
    pair = paste0(sample1, ":", sample2)
  ) %>%
  select(-idx1, -idx2)

fst_long$site_class <- gsub(".*fst/|/grenedalf.*", "", fst_long$source_file)
```

# differentiation matrix

```{r}
dxy4 <- fread("../results/vg/hap2_vs_hap1/fst/four/grenedalf_results_genome_pi-between.csv")

pi4 <- list.files(path = "../results/vg/hap2_vs_hap1", pattern = "grenedalf_results_genome_diversity.csv", recursive = T, full.names = T)

pi4 <- pi4 %>% 
  set_names() %>% 
  map_dfr(~fread(.x, col.names = c("chrom","start","end","total.masked","total.missing","total.empty","total.numeric","total.invariant","total.passed","missing","numeric","passed","theta_pi","theta_watterson","tajimas_d")), .id = "source_file")

pi4$sample_id <- gsub("/", "", str_extract(pi4$source_file, "/[1-8]/"))

pi4$site_class <- gsub("diversity/|/grenedalf", "", str_extract(pi4$source_file, "diversity/.*/grenedalf"))

pi4 <- pi4 %>% filter(site_class == "four")

# reformat grenedalf table into matrix
pi_long <- dxy4 %>%
  select(matches("^\\d+:\\d+\\.pi-between$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "pair", values_to = "pi") %>%
  mutate(pair = str_remove(pair, "\\.pi-between$")) %>%
  separate(pair, into = c("i", "j"), sep = ":", convert = TRUE)

n <- max(pi_long$i, pi_long$j)

pi_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, n, n, dimnames = list(1:n, 1:n))
pi_mat[cbind(pi_long$i, pi_long$j)] <- pi_long$pi
pi_mat[cbind(pi_long$j, pi_long$i)] <- pi_long$pi

diag(pi_mat) <- pi4$theta_pi

rownames(pi_mat) = c("1P", "1W", "2P", "2W", "3P", "3W", "4P", "4W")

colnames(pi_mat) = c("1P", "1W", "2P", "2W", "3P", "3W", "4P", "4W")

# diversity heatmap
# dxy4/pi-between off diagonal
# pi4 on diagonal
pi_df <- pi_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("row") %>%
  pivot_longer(-row, names_to = "col", values_to = "pi") %>%
  mutate(
    row   = factor(row, levels = rownames(pi_mat)),
    col   = factor(col, levels = colnames(pi_mat)),
    label = round(pi, 4)
  ) %>%
  filter(as.integer(row) >= as.integer(col))

ggplot(pi_df, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = pi)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_scico(palette = "lajolla", name = "\u03c04", direction = -1, begin = 0.25) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(pi_df$row))) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

ggsave(paste0("../../results/by-date/", today, "/pi4_dxy4_heatmap.pdf"), device = cairo_pdf, width = 6, height = 6)
ggsave(paste0("../../results/by-date/", today, "/pi4_dxy4_heatmap.png"), width = 6, height = 6)

# fst matrix
fst_mat <- fread("../results/vg/hap2_vs_hap1/fst/four/grenedalf_results_genome_fst-matrix.csv")

fst_mat$fst = c("1P", "1W", "2P", "2W", "3P", "3W", "4P", "4W")
colnames(fst_mat) = c("fst", "1P", "1W", "2P", "2W", "3P", "3W", "4P", "4W")

fst_df <- fst_mat %>% 
  pivot_longer(-fst, names_to = "col", values_to = "Fst") %>%
  mutate(
    row   = factor(fst, levels = fst_mat$fst),
    col   = factor(col, levels = colnames(fst_mat)),
    label = round(Fst, 3)
  ) %>%
  filter(as.integer(row) >= as.integer(col))

ggplot(fst_df, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = Fst)) +

  )
```

# estimation of haplotype mixtures 

```{r}

freqk_calls <- list.files(path = "/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/brandvain_lab_projects/lepto/workflow/results/freqk/hap2_vs_hap1", pattern = "calls.txt", full.names = T)

#freqk_index <- fread("/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/brandvain_lab_projects/lepto/workflow/results/freqk/hap2_vs_hap1/ref_index.txt")

freqk_calls <- read_delim(freqk_calls, id = "file_path", delim = "|", col_names = c("x1", "x2"))

#freqk_calls <- freqk_calls %>% filter(!is.na(x1), !is.na(x2))

freqk_calls$sample <- gsub("/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/brandvain_lab_projects/lepto/workflow/results/freqk/hap2_vs_hap1/|_calls.txt", "", freqk_calls$file_path)

freqk_calls <- freqk_calls %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  select(x1, x2, sample, row_id)

fixed_diff <- freqk_calls %>% 
  mutate(sample = as.numeric(sample)) %>%
  filter(sample %% 2 == 0, x2 >= 1 - 1/50) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  count(row_id) %>%
  filter(n == 4)

freqk_pink <- freqk_calls %>%
  mutate(sample = as.numeric(sample)) %>%
  filter(sample %% 2 == 1, row_id %in% fixed_diff$row_id, x2 <= 0.5, x2 > 0)

freqk_pink %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarize(q = median(x2, na.rm = T))

ggplot(freqk_pink, aes(x = x2)) +
  facet_grid(~sample) +
  geom_density() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.45)

# 2. Compute the kernel density estimation
density_estimate <- density(freqk_pink %>% filter(sample == 5) %>% pull(x2))

# 3. Find the x-value (the mode) where y is maximized
continuous_mode <- density_estimate$x[which.max(density_estimate$y)]

print(continuous_mode)
```

# coverage from mpileup

```{r}

mpileup_files <- list.files(path = "../results/vg/hap2_vs_hap1", pattern = "\\.mpileup$", recursive = T, full.names = T)

mpileup <- mpileup_files %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map_dfr(~fread(
    #cmd = paste0("awk '(($2 < 13129007  && $2 > 9882050))' ", .x, " | cut -f 2,4 --delimiter='\t'"),
    cmd = paste0("awk '(($2 < 12046688  && $2 > 10964369))' ", .x, " | cut -f 2,4 --delimiter='\t'"),
    col.names = c("pos", "depth")), 
    .id = "source_file")

mpileup$sample_id <- gsub("/", "", str_extract(mpileup$source_file, "/[1-8]/"))

total_depths <- mpileup %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  mutate(total_depth = sum(depth),
            norm_depth = depth/total_depth)


# Recode sample_id
sample_map <- c(
  "1" = "1P", "2" = "1W",
  "3" = "2P", "4" = "2W",
  "5" = "3P", "6" = "3W",
  "7" = "4P", "8" = "4W"
)

total_depths <- total_depths %>%
  mutate(sample_id = recode(sample_id, !!!sample_map))

# Split into pair number + type (P/W), then pivot wider on norm_depth
diff_df <- total_depths %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    pair = substr(sample_id, 1, nchar(sample_id) - 1),  # e.g. "1", "2", "3", "4"
    type = substr(sample_id, nchar(sample_id), nchar(sample_id))  # "P" or "W"
  ) %>%
  select(pos, pair, type, norm_depth) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = norm_depth) %>%
  mutate(norm_depth_diff = W - P)

# compare coverage inside vs outside the k-mer mapping region
mpileup %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  filter(pos > 10964369 & pos < 12046688) %>%
  summarize(P_locus_depth = sum(depth)) %>%
  left_join(total_depths, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(P_locus_lambda = P_locus_depth/total_depth)

mpileup %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  filter(pos < 13129007 & pos > 12046688) %>%
  summarize(downstream_locus_depth = sum(depth))  %>%
  left_join(total_depths, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(downstream_locus_lambda = downstream_locus_depth/total_depth)

mpileup %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  filter(pos < 10964369 & pos > 9882050) %>%
  summarize(upstream_locus_depth = sum(depth))  %>%
  left_join(total_depths, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(upstream_locus_lambda = upstream_locus_depth/total_depth)

# coverage scan along the scaffold
ggplot(diff_df %>% slice_sample(prop = 0.01), aes(x = pos, y = norm_depth_diff*1e6)) +
  geom_point(shape = 16) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "lightgrey", se = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(10964369, 12046688), color = "pink") +
  facet_wrap(~pair, nrow = 1, ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = "Position on hap1_scaffold_25 (bp)",
       y = "\u0394 Standardized depth (W-P)",
       title = "Coverage along hap1_scaffold_25") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))

ggsave(paste0("../../results/by-date/", today, "/mpileup_delta_coverage_scan.pdf"), device = cairo_pdf, width = 8, height = 5)
ggsave(paste0("../../results/by-date/", today, "/mpileup_delta_coverage_scan.png"), width = 8, height = 5)

# coverage scan along the scaffold
ggplot(mpileup %>% slice_sample(prop = 0.01), aes(x = pos, y = depth)) +
  geom_point(shape = 16) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = F, span = 0.2) +
  #geom_vline(xintercept = c(10964369, 12046688)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(11818528, 11822704), lty = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~sample_id, nrow = 2, ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = "Position on hap1_scaffold_25 (bp)",
       y = "Read depth",
       title = "Coverage along hap1_scaffold_25")

ggsave(paste0("../../results/by-date/", today, "/mpileup_coverage_scan.pdf"), device = cairo_pdf, width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave(paste0("../../results/by-date/", today, "/mpileup_coverage_scan.png"), width = 8, height = 6)

# depth distribution per sample
ggplot(mpileup, aes(x = depth, fill = sample_id)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  facet_wrap(~sample_id, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Read depth",
       y = "Number of positions",
       title = "Read depth distribution on hap1_scaffold_25") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# MSMC2

```{r}

mu <- 7e-9   # substitute species-appropriate value
gen <- 1       # substitute species-appropriate value
dat <- read.table("/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/brandvain_lab_projects/lepto/workflow/results/msmc2/hap2_vs_hap1/msmc2.final.txt", header=TRUE)

dat$t <- dat$left_time_boundary/mu*gen
dat$Ne <- (1/dat$lambda)/(2*mu)

plot_msmc2 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = t, y = Ne)) +
  # geom_step keeps the discrete time-window step format characteristic of MSMC
  geom_step(linewidth = 1) + 
  # Logarithmic scale is standard for genetic timeline visualization
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "Years ago", y = "Ne")

save_plot <- function(plot_obj, plot_name, date, analysis, plot_base_dir, height, width){
  
  plot_full_name <- paste0(plot_base_dir, "by-date/", today, "/", plot_name)
  
  ggsave(paste0(plot_full_name, ".pdf"), height = height, width = width)
  ggsave(paste0(plot_full_name, ".png"), height = height, width = width)
  
  symlink_pdf <- paste0(plot_base_dir, "by-analysis/", plot_name, ".pdf")
  symlink_png <- paste0(plot_base_dir, "by-analysis/", plot_name, ".png")
  
  if( file.exists(symlink_pdf) ){
    file.remove(symlink_pdf)
  }
  
  if( file.exists(symlink_png) ){
    file.remove(symlink_png)
  }
  
  file.symlink(from = paste0(plot_full_name, ".pdf"), to = symlink_pdf)
  file.symlink(from = paste0(plot_full_name, ".pdf"), to = symlink_png)
}

save_plot(plot_msmc2, "msmc2", today, "msmc2", "../../results/")
```

# Linanthus parryae
```{r}
# ---- 1. Read PAF ----
paf_cols <- c("qname", "qlen", "qstart", "qend", "strand",
              "tname", "tlen", "tstart", "tend",
              "nmatch", "alen", "mapq")

paf <- read_tsv("../results/braker/Linanthus_parryae_vs_hap1.paf", col_names = FALSE, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
paf <- paf[, 1:12]                      # keep only the 12 mandatory columns
colnames(paf) <- paf_cols

paf <- paf %>%
  mutate(across(c(qlen, qstart, qend, tlen, tstart, tend, nmatch, alen, mapq), as.numeric),
         pident = nmatch / alen)        # approximate % identity per alignment block

# ---- 2. Filter low alignment blocks ----
paf_f <- paf %>%
  filter(alen >= 1000, mapq >= 1)

# ---- 3. Orient reverse-strand alignments for correct diagonal direction ----
paf_plot <- paf_f %>%
  mutate(
    tstart_plot = if_else(strand == "-", tend, tstart),
    tend_plot   = if_else(strand == "-", tstart, tend)
  )

# ---- 4. Simple whole-genome dotplot ----
ggplot(paf_plot %>% filter(tname == "scaffold_25")) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = qstart, xend = qend,
                    y = tstart_plot, yend = tend_plot,
                    color = strand),
               linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("+" = "steelblue", "-" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(x = "Query (bp)", y = "Target (bp)",
       title = "minimap2 whole-genome alignment",
       color = "Strand") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

## 5. specific scaffold
for(tscaf in paste0("scaffold_", 1:51)){
    
  ggplot(subset(paf_plot, tname == "scaffold_25")) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = qstart, xend = qend,
                    y = tstart_plot, yend = tend_plot,
                    color = strand),
               linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("+" = "steelblue", "-" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(x ="Haplotype 1, scaffold 25 (bp)",
       title = "minimap2 whole-genome alignment",
       color = "Strand") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  
  ggsave(paste0("../../results/by-date/", today, "/dotplot_hap1_scaffold_25_vs_primary_scaffold_", tscaf, ".pdf"), width = 6, height = 6)
}
```

# Sweep model for MYB cluster

```{r}

# load diversity scan data
div_files <- list.files(path = "../results/vg/hap2_vs_hap1", recursive = T, pattern = "interval_.*_diversity.csv", full.names = T)

div_files <- div_files[grepl("four", div_files)]

div_data <- read_csv(div_files, col_names = c("chrom","start","end","total.masked","total.missing","total.empty","total.numeric","total.invariant","total.passed","missing","numeric","passed","theta_pi","theta_watterson","tajimas_d"), id = "file_path", skip = 1) %>%
  filter(sample %% 2 == 1) %>%
  mutate(mid = (start+end)/2,
         sample = as.numeric(gsub("/diversity", "", str_extract(file_path, "[1-9]/diversity"))))


ggplot(div_data %>% filter(chrom == "hap1_scaffold_25" & end %% 50e3 == 0), aes(x = (start+end)/2, y = theta_pi, color = as.factor(sample))) +
  geom_point() +
  xlim(c(10.5e6, 12.5e6))

# chose extent of sweep data
# pink-specific k-mer region is: scaffold_25:10964369..12046688
# so midpoint of the region is about 11505528.5
# and the window with midpoint 11575000.5 is very close to this, so we'll choose that as our sweep center
# after 140kb diversity drops again, producing a weird model fit, so we'll focus on <= 140 kb away from sweep center
sweep_data <- div_data %>%
  filter(chrom == "hap1_scaffold_25", end %% 50e3 == 0, end <= 12.8e6, end >= 10.8e6) %>%
  mutate(dist_bp = abs(mid - 11.8e6),
         sample = factor(sample),
         sample = fct_recode(sample, "1P" = "1", "2P" = "3", "3P" = "5", "4P" = "7"))

# quick diagnostic plot
ggplot(sweep_data, aes(x = dist_bp, y = theta_pi, color = as.factor(sample))) +
  geom_point()

# Choice of recombination rate
# This is very important. Small values will produce a poor model fit.
# Many large values will produce similar model fits and one can make the 
# estimate of s arbitrarily large by increasing recombination rate.
# Some plant recombination rates:
# Arabidopsis: 8.06452e-10 (stdpopsim)
# Helianthus annus: 4e-09 (stdpopsim)
# Oryza sativa: 8.97e-10 (stdpopsim)
C_const <- 4e-9

pi0_guess <- sweep_data %>% summarize(max=max(theta_pi, na.rm = T))

for(C_const in seq(from = -10, to = -4, by = 0.5)){
  print(C_const)
  C_const <- 10^C_const
fit <- nls(theta_pi ~ pi0 * (1 - exp(-beta*C_const*dist_bp)),
           data = sweep_data,
           start = list(pi0 = pi0_guess$max, beta = 50),
           # upper = c(pi0 = 0.1, b = 100),
           # algorithm = "port",
           control = nls.control(maxiter = 1e6, minFactor = 1e-12, warnOnly = TRUE))
}


summary(fit)
beta_hat <- coef(fit)["beta"]
pi_hat <- coef(fit)["pi0"]
Ne <- 3e5  # plug in your estimate

pvalues <- summary(fit)$coefficients[,4]

# selection coefficient (divide by 2 because its a dominant mutation?)
s_hat <- 2 * log(2 * Ne) / beta_hat * (1/2)

# Generate a smooth prediction curve across the observed distance range
pred_df <- data.frame(
  dist_bp = seq(min(sweep_data$dist_bp, na.rm = TRUE),
                max(sweep_data$dist_bp, na.rm = TRUE),
                length.out = 500)
)
pred_df$theta_pi_hat <- predict(fit, newdata = pred_df)

# Plot observed vs fitted
p <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = sweep_data, aes(x = dist_bp, y = theta_pi, shape = factor(sample)),
             alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5, color = "grey30") +
  geom_line(data = pred_df, aes(x = dist_bp, y = theta_pi_hat),
            color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Distance from sweep site (bp)",
    y = expression(pi[4]),
    title = paste0("Hitchiking model\ns = ", signif(s_hat, digits = 2), ", \u03c0* = ",  signif(pi_hat, digits = 2), ", Ne = ", Ne, ", r = ", C_const, "\np-values = \u03c0*: ", format.pval(pvalues[1], digits = 2, eps = 0.001), ", \u03b2: ", format.pval(pvalues[2], digits = 2, eps = 0.001)),
    shape = "Sample"
  )

p

ggsave(paste0("../../results/by-date/", today, "/hitchhike_model.pdf"), height = 5, width = 6, device = cairo_pdf)

```

# synteny plot

```{r}
#devtools::install_github("Jiawang1209/ggSynteny")
#library(ggSynteny)

#remotes::install_github("loukesio/ggsynteny", upgrade = "never")
library(ggsynteny)

# 1. Load — use the ORIGINAL files (not the _renamed copies)
syn <- read_mcscanx("../results/mcscanx/collinearity/leptosiphon_all.collinearity",
                    "../results/mcscanx/collinearity/leptosiphon_all.gff")

# 2. Display labels: keys = the token before the first dot of the mangled species
sp_fix <- c("hap1" = "Leptosiphon hap1",
            "hap2" = "Leptosiphon hap2",
            "lin"  = "Linanthus",
            "linanthus" = "Linanthus")   # covers both mcscanx-key spellings

# 3. Scaffold number recovery:
#    hapN: ggsynteny strips leading letters -> "1.scaffold_25"; number = trailing digit run
#    linanthus (raw NCBI accessions): ".JALGPY010000001.1" -> JALGPY01 + 6-digit scaffold number
ch <- function(x) {   # mangled chr -> bare scaffold number as character
  n <- ifelse(str_detect(x, "JALGPY"),
              as.numeric(sub(".*JALGPY01([0-9]+).*", "\\1", x)),   # 7-digit serial, greedy
              as.numeric(str_extract(x, "[0-9]+$")))               # hapN: trailing run
  as.character(n)
}
sp_key <- \(x) str_extract(x, "^[^.]+")

# 4. Rebuild both tables in the list
syn$chromosomes <- syn$chromosomes |>
  mutate(species = sp_fix[sp_key(species)], chr = ch(chr))

syn$blocks <- syn$blocks |>
  mutate(across(c(species1, species2), \(s) sp_fix[sp_key(s)]),
         across(c(chr1, chr2), ch))

# 5. Guard: any NA here means an uncaught name regime — fix before plotting
stopifnot(!anyNA(syn$chromosomes$species), !anyNA(syn$blocks$species1),
          !anyNA(syn$blocks$species2), !anyNA(syn$chromosomes$chr))

# 6. Optional: thin the ribbons (1669 blocks raw; package's own precedent is n>=20)
#syn$blocks <- syn$blocks |> filter(n_genes >= 20)

# 7. Plot
plot_synteny(syn,
             species_order = c("Leptosiphon hap2", "Leptosiphon hap1", "Linanthus"),
             palette = "casa_natal", chr_fill = "per_species")

ggsave(paste0("../../results/by-date/", today, "/synenty_all.pdf"), width = 18, height = 5)

# 8. subset to particular focal chromosomes, then plot
picked <- list(
  "Leptosiphon hap1" = c("25"),
  "Leptosiphon hap2" = c("1", "2", "3"),
  "Linanthus"        = c("1", "2", "7")
)

keep <- function(sp, chr) mapply(\(s, c) c %in% picked[[s]], sp, chr)   # unknown species -> dropped

sub_syn <- syn

sub_syn$chromosomes <- syn$chromosomes |> filter(keep(species, chr))
sub_syn$blocks      <- syn$blocks      |> filter(keep(species1, chr1), keep(species2, chr2))

plot_synteny(sub_syn,
             species_order = c("Leptosiphon hap2", "Leptosiphon hap1", "Linanthus"),
             palette = "casa_natal", chr_fill = "per_species")

ggsave(paste0("../../results/by-date/", today, "/synenty_hap1_scaffold_25.pdf"), width = 14, height = 5)
```

# linkage within single reads

```{r}

library(arrow)
threshold <- 0.2

# Point to the file without loading it
file_path <- ("../results/ldx/hap2_vs_hap1/1/1.hap1_scaffold_25.pairs.tsv")

dt_sample <- fread(cmd = paste0("shuf -n 1000000 ", file_path), col.names = c("chrom", "pos1", "pos2", "x11", "x12", "x21", "x22", "pa", "pb", "d1", "d2", "di", "li_mle_r2", "mle_r2", "up_mle_r2", "dc_r2", "A", "a", "B", "b"))

# Create a random filtering mask using a fast internal bernoulli sample
# dt_sample <- ds %>%
#   filter(bernoulli_sample(0.005)) %>%
#   collect() # Only now does the data enter R memory

# calculate distance
dt_sample <- dt_sample %>% 
  mutate(d = abs(pos1-pos2),
         n = 50,
         R2 = dc_r2) %>%
  mutate(bin = cut(d, breaks = 40)) %>%
  group_by(bin) |>
  summarize(d = mean(d),
            R2 = mean(R2),
            n = mean(n),
            S = n()) |>
  select(R2, d, n, S)

# Fit Hill and Weir Non-Linear Least Squares (NLS) Model
hw_model <- nls(
  R2 ~ hill_weir_r2(d, n, C),
  data = dt_sample,
  start = list(C = 0.001),
  weights = S,
  control = nls.control(maxiter = 1000, warnOnly = TRUE)
)

# Extract the fitted recombination parameter (C)
  fitted_C <- coef(hw_model)["C"]
  line1 <- paste("Estimated 4Nc:", signif(fitted_C,3), "\n")
  
  # Generate Predicted Trend Line Values
  pred_distances <- seq(0, max(dt_sample$d), length.out = 1000)
  pred_r2 <- predict(hw_model, newdata = data.frame(d = pred_distances, n = 50))
  plot_data <- data.frame(d = pred_distances, R2 = pred_r2)
  
  # Calculate LD Decay Distance at r^2 threshold (e.g., r2 = 0.2)
  decay_distance <- pred_distances[which.min(abs(pred_r2 - threshold))]
  line2 <- paste("LD decays to r^2 =",
      threshold,
      "at:",
      round(decay_distance / 1000, 2),
      "kb\n")
  
  # Plot the Raw Data Bins and the Fitted Hill & Weir Curve
  ggplot(dt_sample, aes(x = d, y = R2)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, color = "darkgray", shape = 16) +
    #geom_hex() +
    geom_line(
      data = plot_data,
      aes(x = d, y = R2),
      color = "skyblue",
      size = 1.2
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue1", high = "darkblue", trans = "log10") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = threshold,
               linetype = "dashed",
               color = "pink") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = decay_distance,
               linetype = "dashed",
               color = "pink") +
    labs(title = paste(line1,line2, sep = ""), 
         x = "Physical Distance (bp)", 
         y = "LD (r^2)",
         fill = "Count")
  
    ggsave(paste0("../../results/by-date/", today, "/ld_decay.pdf", sep = ""), width = 7, height = 6)

```

# LD decay in 500 kb windows along the genome (pool 1)

The LDx pair tables are many GB, so nothing is ever loaded whole:
Arrow scans the per-scaffold files and pushes the window/bin
aggregation into the scanner; only the compact summary enters R.
Each 500 kb window gets its own decay curve (distance lives in the
0-600 bp range -- LDx pairs never exceed the 500 bp search length).

```{r ld_window_scan}
vb         <- "hap2_vs_hap1"  # results/ldx/{variant}_vs_{backbone} branch
id_pool    <- "1"
window_size<- 5e5            # 500 kb windows along the genome
bin_width  <- 10             # distance micro-bins for the decay curves
max_d      <- 1e3            # pairs past this are anomalies (searchlen = 500)
top_scaffolds <- 50          # biggest scaffolds shown per raster panel
min_pairs_fit <- 50         # per-window NLS needs >= this many pairs
min_bins_fit  <- 4           # ... spanning >= this many distance bins
recompute  <- FALSE          # TRUE forces the expensive re-scan

# n = chromosomes for the Hill-Weir plateau diagnostic only (see
# ld_decay_global): rventures::hill_weir_r2 caps expected r^2 at
# (10/22)*(1 + 36/(22*n)) -- 0.55 at n = sample_size for pool 2 --
# far below LDx's 0.6-0.9 r^2_direct at short distances, so the decay
# fit itself is the empirical log-distance model (Feder et al. 2012).
smp     <- fread("../../config/samples.tsv")
k       <- smp[as.character(sample_id) == id_pool, sample_size]
n_chrom <- if (length(k) && !is.na(k)) k else stop("sample size not found!!!")

dir_pairs <- paste0("../results/ldx/", vb, "/", id_pool)
sum_csv   <- paste0(dir_pairs, "/", id_pool, "_ld_decay_windows.csv")

# headerless 20-col LDx rows (see ldx.smk): names assigned positionally
ldx_schema <- arrow::schema(
  chrom = arrow::string(),  pos1 = arrow::float64(), pos2 = arrow::float64(),
  x11 = arrow::float64(), x12 = arrow::float64(), x21 = arrow::float64(),
  x22 = arrow::float64(), pa = arrow::float64(), pb = arrow::float64(),
  d1 = arrow::float64(), d2 = arrow::float64(), shared = arrow::float64(),
  r2_mle_lo = arrow::float64(), r2_mle = arrow::float64(),
  r2_mle_hi = arrow::float64(), r2_direct = arrow::float64(),
  A = arrow::float64(), a = arrow::float64(), B = arrow::float64(),
  b = arrow::float64())

if (recompute || !file.exists(sum_csv)) {
  ds_files <- list.files(
    dir_pairs, pattern = "\\.pairs\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)
  stopifnot("no per-scaffold pairs.tsv under dir_pairs" = length(ds_files) > 0)

  # remove emptry files
  ds_files <- ds_files[file.size(ds_files) > 0]
  
  ds <- arrow::open_dataset(
    ds_files, format = "tsv", schema = ldx_schema)

  # one pushdown pass: bin = distance bin index; win = 500 kb window idx.
  # mean_sq lets sd be rebuilt in R (sd() itself has no Arrow aggregate).
  # filter out inflated number of 1's for direct method and 0's for mle method
  dt_bins0 <- ds %>%
    mutate(d   = abs(pos2 - pos1),
           win = as.integer(floor(pos1 / window_size)),
           bin = as.integer(d / bin_width)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(r2_direct)) %>%
    group_by(chrom, win, bin) %>%
    filter(r2_direct < 1, r2_mle > 0) |>
    summarise(n        = n(),
              mean_r2  = mean(r2_direct),
              mean_sq  = mean(r2_direct * r2_direct),
              mean_r2m = mean(r2_mle, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups  = "drop") %>%
    collect()

  dt_bins <- dt_bins0 %>%
    mutate(win_start = win * window_size,
           d     = bin * bin_width + bin_width / 2,
           sd_r2 = sqrt(pmax(mean_sq - mean_r2^2, 0))) %>%
    select(-win)

  far <- dt_bins %>% filter(d >= max_d)
  if (nrow(far))
    message("dropping ", sum(far$n), " pairs with d >= ", max_d,
            " bp (searchlen anomalies) on: ",
            paste(unique(far$chrom), collapse = ", "))
  dt_bins <- dt_bins %>% filter(d < max_d, mean_r2 >= 0)

  fwrite(dt_bins, sum_csv)
} else {
  dt_bins <- fread(sum_csv)
}

cat(sprintf("%s pairs in %d windows across %d scaffolds\n",
            sum(dt_bins$n),
            nrow(dt_bins %>% distinct(chrom, win_start)),
            nrow(dt_bins %>% distinct(chrom))))
```

```{r ld_decay_global}
# genome-wide curve: all windows+scaffolds pooled per distance bin
gb <- dt_bins %>%
  group_by(bin) %>%
  summarise(n_bin = sum(n),
            r2_bin = sum(n * mean_r2) / sum(n),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(d = (bin + 0.5) * bin_width)

# empirical decay fit (LDx-paper style, Feder et al. 2012 Fig 4):
# distance-class bin means + log-distance regression. Hill-Weir NLS is
# NOT used: its curve caps at (10/22)*(1+36/(22*n_chrom)), below the
# 0.6-0.9 r2_direct LDx reports at short distances (ascertained pairs,
# upward-biased direct estimator), so its NLS had no headroom.
hw_cap <- (10 / 22) * (1 + 36 / (22 * n_chrom))
head_mean <- dt_bins %>%
  filter(bin * bin_width < 100) %>%
  summarise(sum(n * mean_r2) / sum(n)) %>%
  pull()
ldfit  <- lm(r2_bin ~ log10(d), data = gb, weights = n_bin)
a_int  <- coef(ldfit)[["(Intercept)"]]
b_log  <- coef(ldfit)[["log10(d)"]]
decay_d <- if (b_log < 0) 10^((0.2 - a_int) / b_log) else NA_real_
pred_d  <- seq(min(gb$d), max(gb$d), length.out = 500)
pred_df <- data.frame(d = pred_d, R2 = predict(ldfit, data.frame(d = pred_d)))

today_dir <- paste0("../../results/by-date/", today)
dir.create(today_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

gcur <- ggplot(gb, aes(x = d, y = r2_bin)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_bin)) +
  geom_line(data = pred_df, aes(x = d, y = R2),
            color = "skyblue", linewidth = 1.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 0.2, linetype = "dashed", color = "pink") +
  #geom_vline(xintercept = decay_d, linetype = "dashed", color = "pink") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 8) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(title = sprintf("pool %s (n = %d): head mean r^2 = %.2f vs\nHill-Weir cap %.2f; r^2 = 0.2 at %.2f kb", id_pool, n_chrom, head_mean, hw_cap, decay_d / 1000),
       x = "Pair distance (bp)", y = "LD (r^2)", size = "# Pairs")
gcur

ggsave(file.path(today_dir, paste0(id_pool, "_ld_decay_windows_global.pdf")), gcur,
       width = 7, height = 6)
```

```{r ld_r2_windows}
# mean r^2 per 500 kb window for merging with other windowed tables.
# Keyed exactly like the pooled grenedalf diversity windows (prefixed
# chrom, 1-based start, window end) so it left_join()s straight onto pi4
# and onto cds_windows.bed after the usual gsub("hap1_") + start+1 hop.
# The window mean is pair-count-weighted over the distance bins inside
# it, consistent with the global curve's bin averages.
ld_win <- dt_bins %>%
  group_by(chrom, win_start) %>%
  summarise(n_pairs        = sum(n),
            mean_r2_direct = sum(n * mean_r2) / sum(n),
            mean_r2_mle    = sum(n * mean_r2m, na.rm = TRUE) /
              sum(n[!is.na(mean_r2m)]),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(start = win_start + 1,
         end   = win_start + window_size) %>%
  select(chrom, start, end, n_pairs, mean_r2_direct, mean_r2_mle)

fwrite(ld_win, paste0(dir_pairs, "/", id_pool, "_r2_windows.csv"))

# sanity: does it merge with the diversity + CDS windows as-is?
if (!exists("cds")) {
  cds <- fread("../results/cds_windows/cds_windows.bed",
               col.names = c("chrom", "start", "end", "cds"))
}
cds_ld <- cds %>%
  mutate(chrom = gsub("^", "hap1_", chrom), start = start + 1) %>%
  left_join(ld_win, by = c("chrom", "start", "end"))

cds_ld %>%
  summarise(n_cds_windows = n(),
            windows_with_r2 = sum(!is.na(mean_r2_direct)),
            mean_cds_bases  = mean(cds),
            mean_r2_direct  = weighted.mean(mean_r2_direct,
                                            w = !is.na(mean_r2_direct),
                                            na.rm = TRUE))

if(!exists("pi4")){
  pi4 <- fread("../results/vg/hap2_vs_hap1/diversity_pooled/pooled/four/grenedalf_results_pooled_w500000_s0_diversity.csv")
}

pi_ld <- pi4 %>%
  left_join(ld_win, by = c("chrom", "start", "end")) |>
  left_join(cds |> mutate(chrom = gsub("^", "hap1_", chrom), start = start+1), by = c("chrom", "start", "end")) |>
  mutate(cds_density = cds/(end - start + 1))

pi_ld %>%
  summarise(n_div_windows = n(),
            windows_with_r2 = sum(!is.na(mean_r2_direct)))
```

```{r ld_vs_cds_and_pi}
bs_model <- function(data, indices) {
  df_boot <- data[indices, ]               # Resample the dataset
  fit <- lm(pooled.theta_pi ~ cds_density + mean_r2_direct, data = df_boot)   # Fit the lm model
  return(coef(fit))                        # Return coefficients
}

# 2. Run the bootstrap (e.g., 2000 replications)
#set.seed(123) # For reproducibility
library(boot)
boot_results <- boot(data = pi_ld, statistic = bs_model, R = 1000)

boot.ci(boot_results, type = "basic", index = 2) 

# 2. Loop through each coefficient index and extract the "basic" interval
num_coefs <- 3
coef_names <- c("Intercept", "CDS density", "Mean R2")
ci_list <- lapply(1:num_coefs, function(i) {
  # Run boot.ci for the specific coefficient index
  res <- boot.ci(boot_results, type = "basic", index = i)
  
  # Extract the lower and upper bounds (found in the last 2 positions of the basic vector)
  # res$basic contains [conf_level, index1, index2, lower_bound, upper_bound]
  data.frame(
    Term = coef_names[i],
    Estimate = boot_results$t0[i],
    Lower_CI = res$basic[4],
    Upper_CI = res$basic[5],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

ci_table <- do.call(rbind, ci_list)
rownames(ci_table) <- NULL # Clean up row names

ggplot(ci_table %>% filter(Term != "Intercept"), aes(x = Term, y = Estimate)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = Lower_CI, ymax = Upper_CI), color = "red", linewidth = 3) +
  geom_point(shape = 16, color = "black", size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 20)) +
  labs(y = "Block bootstrap estimate of\nscaled coefficient", x = "Model term", title = "\u03c0 ~ Mean R^2 + CDS density")

ggsave(file.path(today_dir, paste0(id_pool, "_bootstrap_coefficients.pdf")),
       width = 7, height = 6, device = cairo_pdf)
```
